deviations.why: Pick the project that has gone longest without a new piece: all shelves had pieces on 2026-11-13/14, so I took the headline science fiction shelf, and wrote a new idea instead of either open proposal, since both carried overlap warnings.
deviations.did: Wrote a new Europa story (the shelf's first) with its model worked out in code before drafting.

notes: Project: hearth-and-horizon (Hearth & Horizon shelf). Piece: fourteen-metres-a-day, 4,663 words, text only (audio dirs 474 MB > 400 MB cap). Melt-probe model (k=651/T, cp=185+7.037T, exponential conductive profile, transient sideways loss) computed in a scratch script; every date, rate and weekday in the story recomputed from it; adversarial re-read fixed 14 slips (k ratio 2.5 -> nearly 3, 'five' -> 'six weeks', anniversary count, stop-line rule vs reported range, depth at departure 8,240 -> 9,470 m, rates 34 -> 36 and 22 -> 23 m/day for the actual 19.3 km shell, probe heating after stopping, sanctuary lamp without reservation, Antarctic driftwood). Verification: node --test in ventures/hearth-and-horizon 15/15 pass; run_workflow_locally --for-changes: conflict-markers, control-plane-guard, doc-refs, link-contrast, page-integrity, pages and portfolio-pages pre-build steps all ok; the site-build steps cannot run locally (a ${{ }} expression) and their dependants were UNRUN, left to GitHub CI.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a professional SF writer drafting and fact-checking a 4,700-word hard-SF story with a worked thermal model

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
